findings.evidence: Replaced the npm-version-sensitive vulnerable-range esbuild override with exact esbuild 0.28.2, regenerated the lock from a clean npm 10 graph, and proved clean installs plus zero-vulnerability audits on Darwin arm64/x64 and Linux arm64/x64.
build:cli:workspaces invokes explicit -w package targets, not the root build script. The build completed repeatedly in the master qualification and every final platform lane.
Qualification logs are bounded to 2 MiB while preserving head, tail, original byte count, and full-output SHA-256; Unicode and minimum-budget negative controls execute.
Subject hashing now rejects symbolic links and has an executable negative control, preventing traversal outside the reviewed tree.
Artifact stat failures now produce a failed evidence verdict instead of escaping as an exception; broken-link evidence is tested.
The direct tests/unit subject enumeration now excludes .tsbuildinfo and .orig files consistently with recursive enumeration.
Buffer is imported explicitly from node:buffer and the truncation self-test executes.
Slice 1A requires Node >=22, where performance is a documented global; the qualification runner executes performance.now successfully on Node 22, 24, and 26 lanes.
The upper-mid invariant always advances low on success and lowers high on failure; the Unicode truncation negative control terminates and proves the byte ceiling.
A fresh repository reproduction and the committed qualification negative control both prove that git ls-files after -- honors :(glob)tests/unit/modular-* and finds modular-hidden.test.ts.
The exact assertion executes in the qualification negative-control suite and matches the stable application-owned error text.
Manifest and portable contract validation now reject assets naming a syntactically valid but nonexistent contribution; a runtime regression test proves the failure path.
The reviewer prompt renderer displayed [...pkg.dependencies] as [. ..pkg.dependencies]. The repository contains the valid spread token; node --check succeeds and all 77 contract tests execute.
Replaced recursive graph traversal with iterative traversal and added a 20000-level regression test.
Optional chaining spans both indexed access and trim invocation; missing trust IDs produce undefined and enter the intended validation failure.
Diagnostic richness is a maintainability suggestion, not an acceptance correctness defect; duplicate IDs are deterministically rejected.
Both canonical ID arrays use the same ASCII comparator and constrained identifiers; numeric human ordering is irrelevant to set equality.
The frozen contract permits valid SemVer host versions and delegates prerelease compatibility to semver range satisfaction; stable-only hosts are not a requirement.
JSON.parse accepts duplicate keys and a reviver cannot observe overwritten duplicates. The scanner is followed by JSON.parse and has escaped-key and nested duplicate regression coverage.
validRange is imported from semver in packages/mod-api/src/manifest.ts and preserved as an ESM import in the built chunk; 74 contract tests and external consumer compilation pass.
The reviewer explicitly marked this a low-confidence diff-view nit; authoritative generated schemas validate against fixtures and packaged-schema byte parity passes.
